page_copy.subtitle: Not every pattern needs quantum analysis. It is used when a relationship might involve complicated interactions, sequencing, regimes or path dependence that simpler analysis could miss. Quantum Edge is Qadam’s independent proof room for deciding whether a nonlinear or quantum-assisted method genuinely contributes something that the best conventional method missed. The framework presents the experiment record first, then any strategy and paper impact, and closes with the formal market-level verdict.
page_copy.title: Quantum Edge

current_capability.body: Qadam has reproduced its quantum experiment through local simulation and can access the configured Q-CTRL/IBM provider path. guidance.introduction: Quantum analysis earns a role in Qadam’s research process only when it clears six increasingly demanding standards—from infrastructure access to measurable decision value under paper-trading governance.

operating_model.body: Even when genuine IBM hardware is used, classical computing remains essential. It prepares the data, constructs circuits, submits jobs, decodes measurements, runs matched comparisons, and operates Qadam.
operating_model.label: Operating model
operating_model.title: Hybrid by design—not a standalone quantum computer.

guidance.outcome_introduction: The evidence can support one of five governed conclusions.

outcome_states.description: The quantum-assisted method finds useful information beyond the strongest conventional method.
outcome_states.label: Incremental quantum evidence

outcome_states.description: Quantum supports the same conclusion as the conventional method, but does not show a unique advantage.
outcome_states.label: Corroborated classical signal

outcome_states.description: The conventional method performs equally well or better.
outcome_states.label: Classical method preferred

outcome_states.description: The more demanding test reduces confidence in the relationship Qadam originally found.
outcome_states.label: Original thesis weakened

outcome_states.description: Required evidence is missing, so the contribution cannot yet be measured.
outcome_states.label: Insufficient evidence

possible_outcomes: Remain unmeasurable because evidence is missing.

proof_steps.meaning: Checks whether the same method produces the same result again, rather than a one-off outcome.

proof_steps.label: Matched classical benchmark
proof_steps.meaning: Compares the quantum-assisted method with Qadam’s strongest conventional method using the same evidence and rules.
proof_steps.question: Did it beat the strongest fair classical comparison?

proof_steps.label: Untouched holdout validation
proof_steps.meaning: Checks whether the advantage remains on market data that was never used to develop or tune the method.
proof_steps.question: Did that advantage survive completely untouched market data?

proof_steps.label: Governed paper-decision impact
proof_steps.meaning: Asks whether the added evidence materially improved a paper decision while Qadam’s normal governance and risk controls remained in place.
proof_steps.question: Did it ultimately improve a governed paper decision?

guidance.proof_support: The standards are cumulative: passing an earlier stage does not satisfy the stages that follow.

classical_preferred.text: This is a useful scientific result. It means the simpler conventional method explains the evidence just as well as, or better than, the more complicated method. Qadam should prefer the simpler method.

classified_vs_eligible_windows.text: Classified windows have been inspected and categorized. Eligible holdout windows also satisfy the stricter point-in-time, completeness, and independence rules. The current record has 6232 classified windows and 0 eligible windows.

current_proof_state.text: A market-level quantum edge has not been proven. Qadam has shown that its testing process works, but it has not shown that a quantum-assisted method improves predictions on real untouched market evidence.

engineering_mechanism.text: These checks test the experimental machinery. They cover frozen inputs, reproducibility, lineage, safety, and authority isolation. A complete engineering score certifies the test rig, not predictive or investment performance.

engineering_vs_market_proof.text: The engineering score is 11/11: it tests whether the experimental machinery works. The market-proof score is 1/6: it tests whether the investment claim has evidence. It is like proving an engine works on a test bench without yet proving that it wins races.

ibm_hardware.text: The current record shows that no IBM hardware experiment was authorized, submitted, completed, or verified. A prepared circuit manifest and a local simulation are not hardware execution.

local_quantum_simulation.text: This ran on a simulator, not IBM quantum hardware. It demonstrates that the software path and circuit logic can be reproduced, but it does not establish quantum-hardware performance or market advantage.

market_proof_prerequisites.text: These checks show what is still required before Qadam may claim market value. Currently passed: access to the configured quantum provider. Still incomplete: complete, time-stamped provider history, untouched market evidence, a verified IBM hardware result, robustness checks on untouched evidence, a fair classical-versus-quantum result. Provider access alone is not an IBM experiment or a market advantage.

matched_classical_comparison.text: No winner exists until both methods are tested on the same unseen evidence. If the fair comparison has not run, the result is not measurable; it is neither a quantum loss nor a classical win.

paper_outcome_lineage.text: This count changes only after validated evidence affects a governed paper decision and the resulting paper outcome is recorded. A zero means no paper decision or result can currently be traced to validated quantum evidence.

provider_access.text: Access is not execution. This confirms only that Qadam can reach the configured provider path. It does not mean a quantum circuit was run or that a result exists.

provider_history.text: Provider-history rows are raw time-stamped records. Completed partitions are validated, coherent groups ready for point-in-time testing. Raw rows in incomplete or failing partitions cannot create eligible holdout evidence by themselves.

strategy_influence.text: No strategy may change because of quantum evidence until the contribution passes independent market validation. A simulator, synthetic fixture, provider connection, or prepared manifest cannot do that. Current strategy count: 0.

strongest_evidence.text: This is a known-answer synthetic test. Qadam deliberately used data containing a relationship it already knew was there, then checked whether the classical and local quantum methods could recover it. Passing shows that the test machinery works; it does not prove a market edge.

untouched_holdout.text: An untouched holdout is market history kept completely out of discovery and tuning, then opened only for the final test. Without eligible untouched evidence, Qadam cannot fairly measure whether either method generalizes to unseen markets.
